item.title: AAA advises drivers to watch for deer on drive home as the sun sets earlier
item.description:
The sun sets earlier in the evening after the clocks were set back Sunday for Daylight Saving Time, which means some people will be driving home in the dark while deer are at peak activity for the day.

AAA is advising drivers to keep an eye out for deer and warn them that swerving to avoid one can be deadly.

“Every instinct tells you to swerve, but following that instinct is often what gets people hurt,” AAA spokesperson Carly McKinnis wrote in a press release.

The post AAA advises drivers to watch for deer on drive home as the sun sets earlier appeared first on ABC17NEWS.

item.title: Roberts leads No. 23 Missouri past Arkansas | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description:
FAYETTEVLLE, Ark. — Jamal Roberts ran for 138 yards and scored twice, and Darris Smith recovered a fumble in the end zone for a score as No. 23 Missouri topped host Arkansas 34-10 Saturday night.
Roberts has five games this season with at least 100 yards rushing.
Missouri (6-2, 3-2 Southeastern Conference) scored 24 points off four Arkansas turnovers. Linebacker Nick Rodriguez forced a fumble and Trajen Greco added an interception.

item.title: Blair Oaks falls to Borgia in Class 3 volleyball quarterfinals | Jefferson City News-Tribune

That flawless finish sent the Lady Knights to the Class 3 volleyball Final Four with a 16-25, 25-17, 23-25, 25-21, 15-7 win in Saturday afternoon’s state quarterfinal match against the Blair Oaks Lady Falcons at Blair Oaks High School.
